coverage_assessment: Open-web first pass: 15 one-query-per-call searches with 374 returned records and 73 source cards (27 opened, 46 search_only). Broad and weekly Spanish searches covered Jan 1–7, Jan 8–14, Jan 15–21, Jan 22–31, with targeted health, quarantine, accountability, transport, gas-price, Cusco and Puno follow-up and an exploratory Quechua/Aymara keyword query. All 135 rows in Defensoría Report 203 pp.106–116 received a first-pass disposition: 16 candidate/grouped rows mapped to 9 candidates, 15 explicit exclusions, and 104 unresolved leads; the unresolved rows were not verified for turnout, target, physical end or episode boundary. Eleven candidates remain: 2 proposed_include and 9 pending_threshold. E004 has a reported 200 at the Lima Minsa site and E007 qualitative hundreds; E001 turnout is contested. All candidate physical ends and seven state-response dimensions remain unknown; E001 route obstruction is not coded as dispersal. December agrarian action is earlier-onset context; Jan 28 Espinar physical onset is documented but turnout remains pending; January/February boundaries remain open. Q005 has seven unrecoverable original title/URL fields. La República/Diario EP exact-URL ordinary HTTPS attempts failed at DNS before connecting. No fluent local-language review or systematic local archive survey; open-web results do not reproduce LexisNexis and do not establish exhaustiveness or absence. Official baseline and ccode remain pending.
